rejected_alternatives.fit_rationale: Best for focused conversational or structured-output tasks with zero or minimal tools.
Simplest reliable pattern when a single LlmAgent can invoke cohesive FunctionTools.
Ideal for deterministic multi-step pipelines (e.g., intake -> analysis -> synthesis) where order is strict.
Best when multiple independent research or data-gathering sub-agents can execute concurrently.

root_agent.description: Design a Google ADK 2.12 graph_workflow, not a live voice agent. Use a Workflow with FunctionNode and JoinNode. No audio
root_agent.instruction: You are the primary agent for: Design a Google ADK 2.12 graph_workflow, not a live voice agent. Use a Workflow with FunctionNode and JoinNode. No audio, video, BigQuery, or code execution tools are required. Build ASTERGRID: a local FastAPI backend and React TypeScript Three.js frontend. The workflow validates a synthetic scenario, builds a seeded world, runs conditions, resource allocation, and accessibility analysis concurrently, joins outputs, performs preflight verification, runs a deterministic simulation, performs outcome verification, applies at most two bounded revisions, and produces a reproducible report. Roles: Scenario Director, Intake, World Builder, Conditions, Resources, Accessibility, Simulation, Critic, Reporter. Deterministic policy mode must work without any model API key; optional Gemini mode is key-gated. Persist with SQLite, stream ordered events over SSE, validate all artifacts with Pydantic. Fictional emergency coordination only; no military targeting or real-world operational use.
root_agent.name: astergrid_root
